description: This file is a controller class in an ASP.NET Core web application, specifically managing user-related actions such as retrieving current user info and logging out. It interfaces with identity management, cookies, and token services.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller providing endpoints for retrieving user info and logout functionality, utilizing identity, claims, and token services.

methods.name: GetCurrentUser
methods.description: GET endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user info.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: POST endpoint to log out the current user, clear related cookies and cache, and log the activity.

methods.name: CreateUserInfo
methods.description: Helper method that constructs a UserInfo object from ClaimsPrincipal, including claims extraction and token retrieval.
